setspec.lessonname: Optimized Drill Practice of TN Native Plant Names

unit.unitinstructions:
Before You Begin: Demographic Survey

Please answer the following 5 quick demographic questions. This information helps us understand how different learners interact with the system and improve the tutor for future users.

Your responses are confidential and used only for research purposes.

🍂 Tennessee Native Plants

This plant identification tutor practices 112 Tennessee native species through photo-based active recall.

  • What you will do: Each card shows a plant photo, and you type the plant's common name from memory.
  • Timing: Study screens last about 12 seconds, drill screens about 10 seconds, review screens about 8 seconds, and correct confirmations last about 0.75 seconds.
  • How it works: Feedback appears immediately after every response, and audio tools can speak the correct answer aloud if you want another cue.
  • Why it helps: Adaptive scheduling brings missed plants back sooner and spaces familiar ones out for stronger long-term field identification.

Watch for leaf shape, flower color, bark texture, and overall growth habit, then begin when you are ready.

learningsession.calculateProbability: p.y = -0.45 + .73* pFunc.logitdec( p.overallOutcomeHistory.slice( Math.max(p.overallOutcomeHistory.length-60,  0),   p.overallOutcomeHistory.length),  .95)+ .52* Math.log(1+p.stimSuccessCount) + 2.17 * pFunc.recency(p.stimSecsSinceLastShown,  .30) ; p.probability = 1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-p.y));  return p
